name: Voxtree
definition: A sparse voxel tree data structure implemented in Rust, designed for maximal CPU performance with a simple surface API. It uses a 64-way branching factor (4x4x4 sub-volumes) and packs node type information into the address field of branch nodes.
summary: Voxtree is a sparse voxel 64-tree data structure in Rust that uses a 4x4x4 branching factor and packed node addresses to maximize CPU performance.
